name: EMV Agentic Payments Framework for Specifications (draft for public feedback)
status: Draft published for feedback on 2026-09-01; the comment period ended on 2026-09-30. On 2026-10-13 the EMVCo news list has no item on the outcome of the comment period; the newsletter Q3 2026 (2026-10-09) still calls it a draft and says it was published "to provide a foundation for further industry engagement and potential specification development"; no final version or new draft is found (EMVCo news list and resource page, 2026-10-13). An EMV Insights article of 2026-11-10 on the Hanoi Board of Advisors meeting says that "Hundreds of comments were submitted during the public review period" and that the Advisors' input will help guide how the Agentic Payment Task Force addresses that feedback, including how Know Your Agent capabilities and interoperable indicators can support the identification of agentic transactions; it names no new draft, final version or date for one (read 2026-11-23).
relevance: The press release of 2026-09-01 says the draft framework for card payments introduces "Intent Services", a shared layer to "register, reference, retrieve and manage consumer-authorised intent before, during and after a transaction", for cases where a consumer delegates authority to an AI agent to buy on their behalf. It says EMVCo has established a dedicated Agentic Payments Task Force and collaborates with the FIDO Alliance, the OpenID Foundation, the OpenWallet Foundation and W3C.
boundary: EMVCo "may consider capabilities related to Know Your Agent (KYA) and Agentic Transaction Indicators to be included in future publications".
